message.content:
This is the **"Select World"** screen from Minecraft (Java Edition).

**Visible Text:**
- **Header:** "SELECT WORLD"
- **Subtext:** "NO SAVED WORLDS YET – CREATE ONE BELOW"

**Visible Buttons:**
- Top left: **SEARCH WORLD**
- Bottom row (left to right):
  - **PLAY SELECTED WORLD**
  - **CREATE NEW WORLD**
  - **EDIT**
  - **DELETE**
  - **RE-CREATE**
  - **SEARCH**

The screen shows an empty world selection area (the large red-tinted box in the center) indicating no worlds have been created yet, with the Nether-themed background visible behind the UI elements.
